apps.notes: Current source only: native addition/multiplication/division. Styling/table/gradient/theme fidelity incomplete; full numerical behavior unverified. Public original APK unmodified and not redistributed.
Basic arithmetic/native clicks. Menus/gestures/full numerical behavior unverified.
Original signed sample executes Activity and creates OK TextView.

Earlier native text-copy/key listener and clean close; current headless VM conformance adds FrameContract and instruction-slice/GC checks. The normal FrameContract passes on desktop Java 17. No worker or independent APK compatibility claim.

Current source: explicit navigation, typed copied extras, preserved input/title, Back override and lifecycle/GC tests. Application observer registration, snapshot mutation, canonical identity, retention/release and callback fault cleanup pass compiled checks. Fresh native navigation/Back/close with GC in observers records 33 interface calls and exits 0. Authored fixture, not independent multi-screen APK evidence; saved-state/pre/post callbacks remain unsupported.
Authored fixture: typed/staged preferences, native save/restart/clear and package/path/link isolation. Apply is synchronous. Not independent notes-app evidence.

Authored compiled fixture: ordered/indexed lists, immediate FIFO queues, duplicate/null/capacity behavior, guest equals, Set/Map operations, iterator and inherited queue override dispatch, live read-only views, GC retention, limits and rejected eviction hooks. Native map copying, live/nested read-only List views, shared iterator aliases, snapshot GC roots and error cleanup are checked. Same ListContract, MapCopyContract and immediate QueueContract pass on desktop Java 17 with Java 8 source/target. Queue waits/workers are covered by the separate Scheduling fixture; queue iterators remain unsupported. No native interaction or independent notes-app evidence. SnapshotContract also passes on Java 17: immutable snapshot iteration across live changes, read-only wrapping, nulls/indexes and guest equality. Rust checks cover GC retention/release, serial guest worker writes, entry ceilings and explicit reentrant-remove rejection with root cleanup. Snapshot creation copies O(n) references; guest join and parallel CPU execution remain unsupported.

Authored compiled APK: class lookup/construction, initialization/access faults, arrays, inherited field aliases and all nine native wrapper TYPE identities; GC, wrong-kind/type and rejected final-write regressions. Same ReflectionContract and PrimitiveContract pass on Java 17 with Java 8 source/target. Primitive metadata does not imply general boxing support. Framework-specific compiled checks add fixed SDK_INT=21, repeated reads, declaring-owner aliases without subclass initialization, and rejected final writes/wrong-kind/type access. SDK checks are separate from desktop Java differential evidence.

Earlier native timer/cancellation/delayed finish evidence. Current compiled headless checks also cover deferred workers, independent identities, queue/monitor waits, interrupt, main Handler result delivery, GC, bounded spinning, faults, capacity and shutdown. Same pure WorkerContract passes on desktop Java 17. Serial shared-heap host executor; no parallel CPU execution. Main/native-bridge waits, worker Looper delivery, priority and sleep/join remain unsupported. Fresh native Start worker delivers the complete result in accessibility state and closes with status 0; its long visible label clips at 360x340. No independent asynchronous workflow claim.

Authored fixture checks BitmapFactory resource, stream and byte-array paths, bounds metadata, XML src, and four AppKit ImageViews. The captured native screenshot showed all three formats. No independent image-app claim; bitmap pixel operations and Canvas remain unsupported.

Original release APK unmodified. Headless replay saves two note rows and renders both titles after Back and a fresh process. A native AppKit window accepted keyboard text and the APK saved it to SQLite. Worker flow and visual fidelity remain unverified. Not redistributed.

Authored compiled fixture: seven PNG cells, native item clicks with long IDs, disabled item and four-cell refresh. Headless checks cover observer self-removal, auto-fit and all stretch modes, replacement/invalidation, GC, limits and failure recovery. At most 1024 materialized cells; viewport recycling, selection and touch scrolling remain unsupported. Not independent image-app evidence.

Authored compiled fixture: child result data is copied at finish, Back cancels, and a real native folder choice returns an opaque URI. Compiled checks cover Intent action/type/data/copy semantics, stopped and finished callers, lifecycle order, window attachment tokens, GC, callback failure cleanup and the 64-grant ceiling. The separate Documents fixture covers bounded queries and streams; writes and persistent grants remain unsupported.

Compiled guest fixture queries a selected directory, decodes and closes three image streams, and preserves filename accessibility labels across GC. Checks cover natural/null-comparator stable sort and mutation faults, URI encoding and read-only segments, seven ScaleType values, file/foreign/ungranted URIs, traversal, symlinks, hard links, nested files, stream snapshot/close, Cursor close, UTF-16 searches and a 64 MiB stream ceiling. Native public-app rendering is verified separately in SwpieView.

Original F-Droid APK unmodified and not redistributed. Native macOS folder selection runs guest directory queries, Comparable sorting and stream decoding, displaying three CENTER_CROP thumbnails. Native clicks open JPEG, PNG and WebP images in the APK full-screen Activity; Escape returns to the grid after each visit, and normal close exits 0. Real ImageContainer Parcelable writers/CREATORs transfer the image stack; setImageURI decodes a granted stream and closes it. Optimized host replay checks one viewer image and Back to three thumbnails with GC and clean close. Host touch replay runs the APK gesture callbacks, checks exact JPEG/PNG/WebP next/previous image bytes, first/last bounds and confirmed tap control hide/show. GIF animation, slideshow, lifecycle auto-hide and full styling remain unproven; velocity estimation is a bounded single-pointer profile. Optimized native mouse taps hide/restore the controls; Escape restores three thumbnails and normal close exits 0. Native mouse-drag verification is pending: the UI automation tool could not locate the window at its drag coordinate, so swipe evidence is host replay only.

Compiled DEX verifies real Parcelable writers/CREATORs, Unicode/wide values, byte positions, nested Bundles/lists/nulls, shallow copies versus transported activity/result state, mutation/GC and throwing callbacks. Host checks cover malformed/truncated data, 4 MiB buffers, 32-level nesting, cycles, recycled use and root cleanup. No Binder, file descriptors, binary marshalling APIs, Java serialization or general Android Parcelable coverage.

Compiled guest callbacks verify MotionEvent copy/local/raw/time/pointer semantics, child translation/capture, OnTouch before default click, disabled and outside-drag behavior, view translation/alpha, timed show/long press, confirmed/double taps, scroll/fling, paused-drag suppression, CANCEL, callback GC/failure cleanup and invalid host events. Single pointer only; no multi-touch, interception, native text-touch parity or Android VelocityTracker differential evidence.
